title: Haplous Tier 3 Approval Envelope v1.1

signature_ed25519_base64.description: 64-byte Ed25519 signature as canonical standard base64 with == padding

description: Ed25519 signature message = UTF-8 bytes of RFC 8785/JCS canonicalization of the entire envelope AFTER removing only signature_ed25519_base64. The signed object includes decision, request_id, payload_digest, approver_id, signer_key_id, signed_at and schema_version. The runner independently computes sha256(JCS(immutable authorization payload)), compares the payload_digest, verifies the approved public key, signed decision APPROVED, expiry and nonce one-time use. This schema alone does not verify signatures.
